implementation.summary: Implemented complete dependency-free Node.js ESM inventory CLI system with cli.mjs, lib/store.mjs, and lib/inventory.mjs. The implementation covers all contract requirements: item registration with strict SKU/name validation, stock operations (receive, reserve, release, ship), quantity validation with overflow protection, aggregate reporting, JSON persistence, and error handling that preserves storage bytes. The system maintains insertion order, stores literal names, handles empty reads without creating files, and validates all state transitions before mutations.
